headline.checksumFailed: The checksum file couldn't be written
headline.notDurable: The destination couldn't confirm the files are saved
headline.undoneBack: Cancelled: the destination is back as it was
headline.undoneRemoved: Cancelled: the copied files were removed

keptDifferent.one: {count} different file left as it was
keptDifferent.other: {count} different files left as they were

headline.nothingToCopy: Nothing to copy: everything was already there

stats.notCheckedHint: Files no checksum file lists: nothing to compare them with.
stats.alreadyThere: {count} already at the destination, not checked

keptDifferent.one: {count} different file left as it was
keptDifferent.other: {count} different files left as they were

stats.notStartedHint: Files the job didn't reach because it was cancelled or stopped.

summary.title: Summary

notRestored.one: {count} file this job replaced couldn't be brought back: their new versions stay.
notRestored.other: {count} files this job replaced couldn't be brought back: their new versions stay.

notRemovedUndo.one: {count} file couldn't be removed (see the report).
notRemovedUndo.other: {count} files couldn't be removed (see the report).

summary.checksumError: The checksum file could not be written: {why}
summary.durabilityError: The destination reported an error while the files were saved to disk: {why}. Check the drive and run the copy again.
summary.reportError: The report could not be saved: {why}

retryHelp.one: Sets up a new copy of just the {count} failed file; press Start to run it.
retryHelp.other: Sets up a new copy of just the {count} failed files; press Start to run it.

questionQueue.copy: Stop copying and stop the queue?
questionQueue.mirror: Stop mirroring and stop the queue?
questionQueue.check: Stop verifying and stop the queue?

stop.notStarted: This job hasn't started yet: nothing was written for it.

left.check: Nothing was changed: a check only reads files.
left.mirror: Files already copied stay; the file in progress is removed. Files deleted in the origin are left in the destination.
left.copyListed: Files already copied stay and are listed in the checksum file; the file in progress is removed.
left.copy: Files already copied stay; the file in progress is removed.

stop.checkedSoFar: Nothing was changed: the files checked so far are in the summary.
stop.removeCopied: The file in progress and the files already copied are removed.
stop.alsoRemove: Also remove the files already copied
stop.alsoRemoveHelp: The destination goes back to how it was. Files this job replaced come back only from a mirror's archive.

finishing.undo: Secopy finishes putting the destination back as it was first, then quits.
finishing.archive: Secopy finishes archiving the files gone from the origin first, then quits.
finishing.delete: Secopy finishes deleting the files gone from the origin first, then quits.

progress.title: Progress
progress.lookingAtSource: Looking at the source and the destination before this job starts…
progress.undoing: Putting the destination back as it was…

smallFiles.name: Small files
smallFiles.help: Files under 8 MB. Many are copied at once, so they're counted together instead of getting a bar each.

progress.resumeHelp: Carries on from where it paused (Space).

pauseHelp.copy: Stops reading and writing until you resume (Space).

cancelHelp.queue: Asks first, then stops this job and the queue (⌘.).
cancelHelp.job: Asks first, then stops the job (⌘.).

copy.systemHint: Files computers leave behind, like .DS_Store, ._ files and Thumbs.db. They're never copied.
copy.title: New copy
copy.dropSource: Drop a directory or files here, or choose them.
copy.dropDestination: Drop the destination directory here, or choose it.
copy.aboutVerifyingText: Copy & Verify reads every copy back from the destination and checks it against the source's checksum; a copy that doesn't match is copied again. Copy only copies: faster, but nothing is checked.
copy.addToQueueHelp: Adds this copy, as set up now, to the Queue; it runs when you start the queue.

notEmpty.one: Already contains {count} item. Identical files will be skipped.
notEmpty.other: Already contains {count} items. Identical files will be skipped.

preflight.identicalHint: Files with the same name, size and date (within 2 seconds) as one already in the destination. They aren't copied or read.

identicalSkipped.one: {count} identical file will be skipped (not checked).
identicalSkipped.other: {count} identical files will be skipped (not checked).

preflight.existingHint: Files with the same name as one already in the destination, but a different size or date. Keep both: the new one is copied with a number added to its name. Overwrite: the one there is replaced. Skip: the one there is left as it is.

stale.one: {count} unfinished file from an interrupted copy will be replaced.
stale.other: {count} unfinished files from an interrupted copy will be replaced.

presets.label: Preset
presets.updateHelp: Saves this source and these choices into the preset “{name}”.
presets.saveAsHelp: Saves this source and these choices as a new preset.
presets.name: Name
presets.discardNew: Your changes to the new preset aren't saved.

delete.message: The preset “{name}” is deleted. Its source and the copies are not touched.
delete.title: Delete preset?

presets.title: Copy presets

empty.what: A copy preset saves a source and its settings (whether that directory itself is copied, and which file types), so a copy you do often is set up in one step: choose the preset in the main window.
empty.how: Create one with “+ New preset”, or with “Save as…” in the main window.

editor.name: Name
editor.atLeastOne: Add at least one file type.

export.title: Export
export.about: Choose what goes in the file. The queue and this Mac's recent destinations stay here.

import.title: Import
import.renamed: Imported as “{name}”: the file has this name twice.

settings.title: Settings
settings.discard: Your changes to the settings aren't saved.

checksumFile.label: Write the checksum file to the destination
checksumFile.help: A {file} file lists every copied file with its checksum, so the copy can be checked again later, for example with {command}.

systemCount.label: Show the count of skipped system files
systemCount.help: Files computers leave behind ({a}, {b}, {c}…) are never copied; this only shows how many were skipped. Every other file is copied, hidden or not.

report.label: Also save the job report next to the checksum file
report.help: Every job's report is also kept in the app; this adds a copy next to the checksum file.

notify.label: Notify when a copy finishes
notify.help: Only when Secopy's window isn't in front. macOS asks for permission the first time.

menuBar.label: Keep copying in the menu bar when the window is closed
menuBar.help: Closing the window during a job hides it; a menu bar icon shows the progress and brings it back. When off, closing asks to stop the job.

transfer.title: Settings and presets
transfer.about: Move your settings and presets to a new Mac, or share presets, in a .secopy file.
transfer.exportHelp: Exports your saved settings; save first to include these changes.

verify.title: Verify
verify.about: Choose the directory of a copy, or a whole drive: Secopy reads every file its checksum files list and compares it. Nothing is written to it.
verify.nothing: No checksum files here: there's nothing to verify. Secopy writes one with every copy and every mirror.
verify.addToQueueHelp: Adds this directory to the Queue; it's verified when the queue gets to it.

startHelp.one: Reads the {count} listed file ({size}) and compares each with its checksum; nothing is written.
startHelp.other: Reads the {count} listed files ({size}) and compares each with its checksum; nothing is written.

queue.title: Queue

clear.message: Every job in the queue is removed.
clear.title: Clear the queue?

queue.empty: Nothing queued. Set up a copy, a mirror or a verify and press Add to queue: it runs here, one after another with the others.

unsupported.newer: A job for a newer Secopy

queue.clearHelp: Removes every job from the queue, after asking.

startHelp.one: Runs the one job in the queue.
startHelp.other: Runs the {count} jobs one after another.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.discardNew: Your changes to the new mirror aren't saved.

delete.message: The mirror “{name}” is deleted. Its origin, destination and archive are not touched.
delete.title: Delete mirror?

empty.what: A mirror keeps a copy of a directory identical to it: new and changed files are copied and verified, and files deleted in the origin are archived (or deleted) in the destination. Nothing is ever written to the origin, and every run shows a preview first.

mirror.addToQueueHelp: Adds this mirror to the Queue; what to copy and remove is worked out again when it runs.

startHelp.copyArchive: Copies and verifies {copied}, then archives {removed} gone from the origin.
startHelp.copyDelete: Copies and verifies {copied}, then deletes {removed} gone from the origin.

preview.archivedHelp: Moved into the hidden .secopy-archive directory in the destination, and removed for good after {days} days.

failing.one: {count} file will fail: a name the destination can't take, or something in the way
failing.other: {count} files will fail: a name the destination can't take, or something in the way

editor.name: Name
editor.daysHelp: In a hidden .secopy-archive directory on the destination, then removed.
editor.deleteNote: Files deleted in the origin are deleted in the destination too. This can't be undone.
editor.verifyNote: New and changed files are always verified after copying: read back from the destination and compared by checksum.
editor.deepCheck: Also compare unchanged files byte for byte
editor.deepCheckHelp: Files with the same size and date are normally left alone. This reads both copies in full to catch a damaged or silently changed file in the backup. Slow on big libraries.
